transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Uh… I guess things at home have been getting to me. Since my father-in-law moved in, I’ve been snapping at my wife over small stuff around the house. I’m putting off paperwork and jobs I’d normally handle, and even when I’m out in the workshop or fishing, I can’t really quiet my head.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

Yeah… I guess anxious is probably the word. Since my father-in-law moved in, I just feel wound up. I snap at my wife over little things, put off stuff I’d normally handle, and even when I’m in the workshop or trying to fish, my head won’t really settle.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don’t know… not exactly sad, I guess. More just worn down. I haven’t really thought of it as being “down.”
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
Hopeless? I… don’t think I’d put it that way. I haven’t really been thinking about the future much.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?
Not as much, no. I still go out to the workshop or try to fish, but… my head doesn’t really quiet down like it used to. It’s hard to enjoy it when I’m still wound up about things at home.
Have you had any episodes where you suddenly felt extremely frightened or intensely anxious for no apparent reason?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get tense sometimes, but not like it comes out of nowhere or anything.
Do you feel like you've been in a low mood most of the time since your father-in-law moved in?

I don’t know if I’d call it low mood most of the time. It’s more like… since he moved in, I’m wound up a lot. I snap at my wife over stupid little house stuff, and I’ve been putting off things I normally handle. Even when I’m in the workshop or fishing, my head just doesn’t really settle.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them at all?
I wouldn’t say no pleasure at all. I still try to do the workshop stuff or go fishing… it’s just, since my father-in-law moved in, I can’t really get my head quiet enough to enjoy it like I used to.
Are there things you used to find pleasurable but now find you have no interest in at all?
Not really “no interest.” I still care about those things… I just don’t always get into them the same way.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?
Not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track, but I don’t think there’s been any big change.
Have you been feeling irritable most of the time since your father-in-law moved in?

Yeah… I guess I have. Mostly at home. Since he moved in, I catch myself snapping at my wife over little stuff around the house, things that shouldn’t really set me off. I don’t like admitting that, but… yeah, I’ve been more on edge.
Do you find yourself having thoughts that keep repeating over and over in your head?
Yeah… I do. It’s like I can’t get my head to quiet down, even when I’m trying to be out in the workshop or fishing. It just keeps circling back to the stuff at home.
Are there things you used to enjoy that you no longer enjoy at all?
I don’t know… not completely, no. I still like some things, just maybe not as much lately. Hard to say.
Do you feel like you've been in a low mood for most of every day since your father-in-law moved in?
I don’t know if I’d say most of every day. I’ve been down some, yeah… but it’s not like that all day, every day.
Have you been feeling sad for most of the day, nearly every day, since your father-in-law moved in?
I don’t think so… not nearly every day. I get sad, sure, but I wouldn’t put it like that.
Have you been feeling sad for more than half of the time since your father-in-law moved in?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had sad moments, but more than half the time… I don’t really know.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time?
I don’t know… “most of the time” feels a bit strong. I’ve had times where I feel pretty down, but I haven’t really been keeping track like that.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight since your father-in-law moved in?
Not that I’ve noticed. My clothes seem about the same, I think.
Have you felt sad for at least two weeks since your father-in-law moved in?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had stretches where I felt sad, but I don’t know if it was a full two weeks straight.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure. I still do some things, but… I guess I haven’t really been paying attention to whether I enjoy them the same way.
